description: Unit test class for the AclModified class, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and creation from JSON.

classes.name: AclModifiedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the AclModified class functionalities.

methods.name: assertImmutability

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the hashCode and equals methods of AclModified using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAcl

methods.description: Tests creating an AclModified instance from valid JSON data.
